title: Victoria Harbour Sunset Kayak Tour
includes: Guide, kayaks, and all paddling equipment included
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children aged 10–15 years must be accompanied by an adult; children aged 3–9 years must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian
policies: Kayaking requires some upper body strength and endurance
Tours require a minimum of two paddlers to run. Alternative options may be provided if this minimum is not met.
Tours typically tale place in tandem kayaks to make the experience smooth for all ability levels. Single kayaks may be used on occasion in the event of uneven numbers.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Watch the day turn into night on this guided, 2.5-hour sunset kayak tour in Victoria Harbour, British Columbia. See brilliant pinks, stunning blues, and dazzling yellows — plus the colours of building and street lights — while traversing the Inner Harbour, Upper Harbour, and historic Gorge Waterway. While on the water, keep an eye out for eagles, herons, river otters, harbour seals, and other marine wildlife in their natural environment. All the necessary equipment is provided on this small-group tour.
